title: Subsequence of Size K With the Largest Even Sum
summary: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, determine the maximum even sum of any subsequence of nums with exactly k elements.
statement: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, determine the maximum even sum of any subsequence of nums with exactly k elements. If no such subsequence exists, return -1. A subsequence is formed by removing some or no elements from the original array while maintaining the order of the remaining elements.
constraints: nums contains nonnegative integers and k is from one through its length.
Choose exactly k occurrences; order does not affect their sum.
Return the maximum even sum, or -1 if no such selection exists.
hints: Begin with the k largest values; only parity can make this unconstrained optimum invalid.
If the sum is odd, swap one chosen odd for the best remaining even, or one chosen even for the best remaining odd.
Evaluate both feasible parity-changing swaps and take their maximum; otherwise return -1.
Any even size-k selection differs in parity by at least one such swap, and using the least loss in either parity class is optimal.
editorial: Any even size-k selection differs in parity by at least one such swap, and using the least loss in either parity class is optimal.

tests.explanation: Selecting 4,5,3 gives the maximum even sum twelve.
Every one-element sum is odd, so no valid selection exists.
